info.title: Google Docs MCP REST API
info.description: REST API for reading Google Docs and managing comments. For use with ChatGPT Custom Actions.

post.summary: Read a Google Document
post.description: Reads the content of a Google Document. Returns plain text by default.

documentId.description: The ID of the Google Document (from the URL)

format.description: Output format: 'text' for plain text, 'json' for raw structure

maxLength.description: Maximum character limit for output. Omit for full content.

tabId.description: Optional tab ID to read a specific tab

format.description: The format of the returned content

content.description: The document content (string for text format, object for json format)

length.description: Length of the content in characters (for text format)

400.description: Bad request - missing documentId

401.description: Unauthorized - invalid or missing API key

get.summary: List all comments in a document
get.description: Returns all comments in a Google Document, including replies.

parameters.name: documentId
parameters.description: The ID of the Google Document

post.summary: Add a comment to a document
post.description: Adds a comment quoting the given range. The Drive API ignores anchors on Google Docs, so the quoted text is the only record of which range the comment refers to — it is read out of the document here. endIndex must be greater than startIndex.

parameters.name: documentId
parameters.description: The ID of the Google Document

startIndex.description: The starting index of the text range (inclusive, 1-based)

endIndex.description: The ending index of the text range (exclusive)

400.description: Bad request - invalid parameters

post.summary: Create a doc from text, HTML or markdown content
post.description: Uploads the content and lets Drive convert it into a Google Doc. The body limit on this path is 5mb, because the content is the whole document. Not idempotent: each call creates another doc.

content.description: The document content, in the source format named by mimeType.

mimeType.description: The SOURCE format Drive converts from, not the result.

400.description: Invalid request body. The response carries Zod issues keyed by field.

post.summary: Convert a .docx already in Drive into a Google Doc
post.description: Copies the file with the Google Docs mimeType so Drive converts it. Takes a Drive file ID, not file bytes. Anything whose mimeType is not .docx is refused with 400, because Drive would convert it into an unreadable document.

400.description: Invalid request body. The response carries Zod issues keyed by field.

post.summary: Append text to the end of a doc or tab
post.description: Resolves the end index itself, so no index is needed. The body limit on this path is 5mb. The response reports the index used and whether a newline was prepended.

tabId.description: Optional tab ID. Defaults to the first tab.

400.description: Invalid request body. The response carries Zod issues keyed by field.

post.summary: Insert text at a 1-based index
post.description: Indices shift as the document changes. For several edits at once use batchUpdate, which orders them so they do not invalidate each other.

tabId.description: Optional tab ID. Defaults to the first tab.

400.description: Invalid request body. The response carries Zod issues keyed by field.

post.summary: Apply up to 50 document operations in one batch
post.description: Index-based operations are applied in descending index order so they do not shift each other. Mixing global replacements (replace_text, find_replace) with index-based operations is refused with 400 rather than reordered, since no ordering preserves the caller intent. Includes delete_text, so this endpoint can remove content.

operations.description: Each operation needs a `type` plus that type fields. Types: insert_text, delete_text, replace_text, format_text, update_paragraph_style, insert_table, insert_page_break, find_replace, create_bullet_list.

400.description: Invalid request body. The response carries Zod issues keyed by field.

post.summary: Replace every occurrence of a string
post.description: The response reports occurrencesChanged, which is 0 when nothing matched — a successful call, not an error.

tabId.description: Optional tab ID. Defaults to the first tab.

400.description: Invalid request body. The response carries Zod issues keyed by field.

post.summary: Delete a character range
post.description: DESTRUCTIVE and irreversible through this API. A POST to an action path rather than a DELETE on the range, so the call site reads as deliberate. endIndex must be greater than startIndex: a zero-width range is a no-op the API would accept, which would read as a successful delete.

tabId.description: Optional tab ID. Defaults to the first tab.

400.description: Invalid request body. The response carries Zod issues keyed by field.

post.summary: Apply character formatting to a range or found text
post.description: The response reports the range that was resolved, which matters when the target was given as text to find. `applied: false` with `fields: null` means no recognised style key was supplied and nothing was written.

target.description: One of: {textToFind, matchInstance}, or {startIndex, endIndex}, or (paragraph only) {indexWithinParagraph}.

400.description: Invalid request body. The response carries Zod issues keyed by field.

post.summary: Apply paragraph formatting by text, index or range
post.description: A text target is widened to the paragraph containing it, so the resolved range in the response is wider than the text matched. `applied: false` means nothing was written.

target.description: One of: {textToFind, matchInstance}, or {startIndex, endIndex}, or (paragraph only) {indexWithinParagraph}.

400.description: Invalid request body. The response carries Zod issues keyed by field.

post.summary: Format the Nth instance of a string
post.description: Flat-parameter alternative to text-style, same engine underneath. At least one formatting option must be present or the body is refused.

400.description: Invalid request body. The response carries Zod issues keyed by field.

post.summary: Insert a table of the given dimensions
post.description: Inserts an empty table at the index.

400.description: Invalid request body. The response carries Zod issues keyed by field.

post.summary: Insert a page break at an index
post.description: Inserts a page break at the index.

400.description: Invalid request body. The response carries Zod issues keyed by field.

post.summary: Insert an inline image from a public URL
post.description: Google fetches the URL server-side, so it must be publicly reachable. Width and height are only applied when both are given.

400.description: Invalid request body. The response carries Zod issues keyed by field.

post.summary: Insert an image from a URL, Drive file, local path or base64
post.description: Exactly one source must be given. Every source except driveFileId UPLOADS a new file to the user Drive and returns its URL, which is a side effect worth knowing about. The base64 path is capped at 20mb decoded, checked from the string length before any buffer is allocated; the body limit on this path is 5mb.

driveFileId.description: An image already in Drive. Made publicly readable so Google can fetch it.

fileName.description: Required with imageBase64, for MIME detection.

400.description: Invalid request body. The response carries Zod issues keyed by field.

post.summary: Export a doc to PDF and save it to Drive
post.description: An export that MUTATES: the PDF is written to Drive and the new file is returned. Anything that is not a Google Doc is refused with 400.

pdfFilename.description: Without extension. Defaults to the document title.

400.description: Invalid request body. The response carries Zod issues keyed by field.

post.summary: Reply to a comment
post.description: Adds a reply under an existing comment thread.

400.description: Invalid request body. The response carries Zod issues keyed by field.

post.summary: Mark a comment resolved
post.description: The `resolved` field in the response is what Google reported on a RE-READ, not what was requested: the Drive API accepts resolving a Google Docs comment and frequently does not persist it. A false value means the call succeeded and the flag did not stick.

400.description: Invalid request body. The response carries Zod issues keyed by field.

post.summary: Delete a comment thread
post.description: DESTRUCTIVE. A POST to an action path rather than a DELETE on the resource.

400.description: Invalid request body. The response carries Zod issues keyed by field.

bearerAuth.description: API key obtained from the registration dashboard

quotedText.description: The text that the comment is anchored to

author.description: Display name of the comment author

resolved.description: Whether the comment has been resolved

author.description: Display name of the reply author
